issues.text: Single day of data (1 d). Weekday and seasonal patterns cannot be observed — they will be inferred, not measured.
1 control case(s) describe a recurring condition with no time window (Sobrecarga recurrente) — they stay in the baselines and are listed as known contamination.

strengths: Time series is gapless at 1 s.

measures.name: Percent Engine Load at Current Engine Speed-Engine

improvements: Add a second week of data so MOMENTUM can model weekday patterns instead of inferring them.
Resolution is already high at 1 s. More days, entities and context columns beat finer resolution.
